events.title: CAC 40 Slides To Lowest Level Since March As Oil, Bond Yields Rise
events.description:
France's equity benchmark CAC 40 tumbled to its lowest level since March on Thursday as stocks shed ground amid rising concerns about inflation and interest rates as oil prices climbed higher and bond yields remained elevated due to geopolitical tensions.

With no progress seen in resolving the Middle East issue, oil prices rose sharply with Brent crude futures surging to $100.79 a barrel.

events.title: Eurozone Manufacturing Activity Gathers Momentum
events.description: The euro area manufacturing activity strengthened in September as production and new orders grew at their sharpest rates since early 2022, final survey results from S&P Global showed Thursday. The final manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index rose to 52.9 in September from 52.7 in the previous month.

events.title: DAX Hits 9-Week Low As Oil Prices, Bond Yields Surge
events.description: Germany's DAX benchmark fell to a near 9-week low Thursday, declining 0.65% amid inflation concerns, rising oil prices, and elevated bond yields. Brent crude climbed nearly 3% to $100.79 a barrel as geopolitical tensions persist.

events.title: Swiss Franc Rebounds Amid Risk-off Mood
events.description: The Swiss franc rebounded from recent lows against other major currencies in the European session on Thursday, as investor sentiment in European stock markets remained weak amidst a hardening in global bond yields.

events.title: Swiss Franc Rises Against Majors
events.description: The Swiss franc strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Thursday.

events.title: UK House Prices Fall Unexpectedly: Nationwide
events.description: UK house prices dropped unexpectedly in September as geopolitical tensions and rising energy prices add fears of interest rate hikes, data from the Nationwide Building Society revealed Thursday. House prices fell 0.2 percent on a monthly basis in September, offsetting a 0.2 percent rise in August. Prices were forecast to remain flat.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Rises On Fed Kashkari Hawkish Remarks
events.description: The U.S. dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Thursday, after the hawkish statement by Minneapolis Federal Reserve (Fed) Bank President Neel Kashkari.

events.title: Weak Sentiment Expected In European Markets On Thursday
events.description: Sentiment in European stock markets is expected to remain weak on Thursday amidst a hardening in global bond yields. Ten-year bond yields have increased more than a quarter percent in Germany, France, U.K., as well as Spain. The easing in crude oil prices, the momentum in tech stocks as well as toned down expectations of another Fed rate hike in October is expected to limit losses.

events.title: Yen Falls After Japan Q3 Tankan Survey Data
events.description: The Japanese yen weakened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Thursday, as Japan business sentiment data rose somewhat but fell short of market expectations.

events.title: Yen Falls Against Majors
events.description: The Japanese yen weakened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Thursday.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Rises Against Majors
events.description: The U.S. dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Thursday.

events.title: Indian Shares Mixed In Cautious Trade; Tech Stocks Rise, Automobiles In Reverse Gear
events.description: Indian shares are turning in a mixed performance Thursday morning as the mood remains cautious due to elevated oil prices and higher U.S. bond yields amid persisting concerns about the situation in the Middle East and rate hike fears, as well as heavy selling by foreign investors over the past several sessions.

events.title: Australian Market Sharply Extends Early Losses In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is sharply extending its early losses in mid-market moves on Thursday, snapping a three-session winning streak, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is falling well below the 8,600 level, with weakness across most sectors led by mining and financial stocks.
